title: Analysis of On-policy Policy Gradient Methods under the Distribution Mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2503.22244v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Policy gradient methods are among the most successful approaches for solving challenging reinforcement learning problems. Despite their empirical success, many state-of-the-art policy gradient algorithms for discounted problems estimate update directions using a sampling distribution that differs from the discounted state distribution required by the policy gradient theorem. In this work, we analyze the impact of this distribution mismatch on policy gradient methods. Specifically, {for tabular direct and softmax parameterizations, we establish global convergence of objective values under biased updates}. {For tabular softmax policies, we further derive the exact leading-order coefficients of the asymptotic objective errors under biased and normalized exact updates. translated_title: 分布失配下同策略策略梯度方法的分析
translated_abstract: 策略梯度方法是解决具有挑战性的强化学习问题最成功的方法之一。尽管在经验上取得了成功，但对于折扣回报问题，许多最先进的策略梯度算法在估计更新方向时所使用的采样分布与策略梯度定理所要求的折扣状态分布并不一致。在这项工作中，我们分析了这种分布失配对策略梯度方法的影响。具体而言，{对于表格型直接参数化和softmax参数化，我们在有偏更新下建立了目标值的全局收敛性}。{对于表格型softmax策略，我们进一步推导了在有偏更新和归一化精确更新下渐近目标误差的精确首阶系数，两者的比值提供了一个明确的判据，用于确定分布失配何时会加速或减缓渐近收敛。}随后，我们将分析扩展到更一般……
tldr: 本文分析了策略梯度方法中采样分布与折扣状态分布失配的影响，证明了表格型参数化在有偏更新下的全局收敛性，并通过渐近误差首阶系数之比给出了分布失配何时加速或减缓收敛的明确判据。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the impact of distribution mismatch in on-policy policy gradient methods, establishes global convergence of objective values under biased updates for tabular parameterizations, and derives exact leading-order coefficients of asymptotic errors whose ratio provides an explicit criterion for determining when distribution mismatch accelerates or slows convergence.
